an4.170:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an4.170:1.3: tatra kho āyasmā ānando bhikkhū āmantesi;
an4.170:1.5: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
an4.170:2.1: yo hi ko ci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattappattiṃ vyākaroti. sabbo so catūhi maggehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an4.170:3.2: idha āvuso bhikkhu samathapubbaṅgamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāveti.
an4.170:3.3: tassa samathapubbaṅgamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
an4.170:3.4: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an4.170:3.5: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti. anusayā vyantīhonti.
an4.170:4.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṃ samathaṃ bhāveti.
an4.170:4.2: tassa vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṃ samathaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
an4.170:4.3: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an4.170:4.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti, anusayā vyantīhonti.
an4.170:5.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāveti.
an4.170:5.2: tassa samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
an4.170:5.3: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an4.170:5.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti. anusayā vyantīhonti.
an4.170:6.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhuno dhammuddhaccaviggahitaṃ mānaṃ
an4.170:6.2: hoti. so āvuso samayo yantaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃyeva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.
an4.170:6.4: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an4.170:6.5: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti. anusayā vyantīhonti.
an4.170:7.1: yo hi ko ci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattappattiṃ vyākaroti, sabbo so imehi catūhi maggehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarenāti.
